meta.caveat: This carrier runs the other way from most (and lists its own 29 competencies under mate-rov so the source reads 29 of 29): the content is the MATE competency catalog (mate-rov.json) and the standards are what each competency draws on. A strength here is how fully that standard describes what the competency asks of a team, not how well anything we teach covers it. Where one standard is cited by several competencies the entry's own strength is the weakest among them and its note gives each competency's reason; by_locator keeps each competency's own strength and reason, and the publish script turns those into the cross-references /standards/ shows between a competency and each standard (tools/publish_standards_data.py). All of it is this project's own reading of the Scout manual and the Floats task description, unproofread.

alignment_log.scope: First pass: 29 competencies against apcsp, castandards, csta2026, ca-ict-anchor, ngss, ca-epc and casel
